| # Rexroth Security Levels {#rexroth-security-levels-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                             |                                                                                                                     |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

For testing, maintenance and support, all series RCs contain Rexroth-defined access levels. Along with each Rexroth-defined access level, a confidential password is stored on the HSM that only Rexroth has knowledge about. In case of a customer support incident or product return, Rexroth is able to restore the RC or to analyze the root cause of the problem that can then be solved in the future.

With these access levels, Rexroth is able to

- Flash and reset the RC

- Clear errors and DTCs

- Access UDS services, read out or manipulate data

Note, that Rexroth is not able to recover or retrieve access level passwords or any other confidential information that is stored on the HSM.

## Disabling Rexroth access levels {#disabling-rexroth-access-levels .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

If desired, the Rexroth access rights can be made permanently unusable by calling the function  bds_sec_scrambleRexrothSecretsPerm. This function randomizes the passwords for all Rexroth levels (all passwords for the remaining levels will stay unchanged).

 

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ![Attention](attention.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.7083in;border:none"} | This is an irreversible operation that permanently disables the Rexroth access levels!                                                                         |
|                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                          | Disabling Rexroth access levels significantly reduces Rexroths capability for analyzing returned RCs and prevents recovering an RC with overwritten passwords. |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
